Documentation.TagDescription: WMS reference data backed by a local SQLite database. No external dependencies required.

MethodDescriptions.GET: Retrieve warehouses of the selected country

MethodDocumentation.GET: Tenant header demo. Rows are restricted to the `X-Country` value selected from the token's allowed tenants (e.g. `NL`, `DE`, `US`). A token without `X-Country` tenants receives `403`. Tenants are set per token in the console under **Access Tokens**.
